name: What happens after a high water pressure diagnosis?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a high water pressure diagnosis?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a high water pressure diagnosis, the plumber will explain their findings and recommend the appropriate solution, which most commonly involves adjusting or replacing your pressure reducing valve (PRV). They will provide a detailed estimate for any recommended repairs or installations. Once approved, the necessary work will be performed to bring your home's water pressure to a safe and optimal level.
acceptedAnswer.description: After diagnosis, the plumber will explain findings, recommend solutions (often PRV adjustment or replacement), and provide an estimate before performing repairs.
